description: This file defines the LocaleUtility class, a utility for working with Java Locale objects within the OpenMRS project. It includes methods for retrieving, comparing, and generating locales, as well as managing locale-related global properties and caching mechanisms.

classes.name: LocaleUtility
classes.description: A utility class for working with Locales in the OpenMRS system, including global property integration and caching mechanisms.

methods.name: getDefaultLocale
methods.description: Retrieves the default locale specified in global properties with caching and fallback.

methods.name: areCompatible
methods.description: Checks whether two Locales are compatible based on language and country criteria.

methods.name: fromSpecification
methods.description: Creates a Locale object from a string specification, supporting various formats.

methods.name: generateLocaleFromLegacyFormat
methods.description: Helper method to parse legacy locale string formats.

methods.name: getLocalesInOrder
methods.description: Returns a set of allowed locales in a predictable order, including the user's preferred locale, default locale, allowed list, and English.

methods.name: setLocalesAllowedListCache
methods.description: Sets the cached list of allowed locales.

methods.name: globalPropertyChanged
methods.description: Resets locale caches when relevant global properties change.

methods.name: globalPropertyDeleted
methods.description: Resets locale caches when relevant global properties are deleted.

methods.name: supportsPropertyName
methods.description: Checks if the property name is relevant to locale configuration.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates a Locale object by checking ISO language and country codes.
